rundown: Warriors beat Kings 129-110 at Chase Center in San Francisco, CA in front of 18,064. Warriors led 72-53 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Warriors won it 44-19.
Leading the way — Kings: Domantas Sabonis 27 pts, 10 reb; Darius Acuff Jr. 9 ast. Warriors: De'Anthony Melton 24 pts; Draymond Green 11 ast; Yaxel Lendeborg 8 reb.

review.body:

Projected to score 103, they scored 110 (+7 points, 7% over); projected to allow 112.6, they allowed 129 (+16.4 points, 15% over).

Warriors came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (9-8, 111.2 scored and 112.1 allowed a game over 17 games), worth about 97 and 99 games of evidence. Projected to score 112.6, they scored 129 (+16.4 points, 15% over); projected to allow 103, they allowed 110 (+7 points, 7% over).

The bigger miss was Warriors' scoring (+16.4 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.
